title: An organization's membership root as its issuer serves it (DEC-0131, DEC-0133)
description: What an organization server answers at GET {issuer}/fabric/membership/v1/{org}/root once the root's first key set is accepted (DEC-0131 OX-2; 404 no-root before): the root members pin in the estate record's organizations (OM-2). The same organization, issuer and root {kid, x} an organizationPin carries; Fabric shows the root's kid and a fingerprint of its x to the person before their passkey signs the pin. docs/specification/membership.md#the-draft-exchange.

root.description: The root's key id and its Ed25519 public key, base64url (32 bytes).
